scripts.check: nub run format:check && nub run lint && nub run typecheck && nub run test
scripts.check:extensions: npm outdated --prefix agent/npm; git -C agent/git/github.com/championswimmer/pi-context-usage fetch origin && git -C agent/git/github.com/championswimmer/pi-context-usage log --oneline HEAD..origin/HEAD
scripts.format: oxfmt package.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json instructions.md agent/scripts/README.md agent/scripts/tui-showcase.ts agent/extensions/*.ts agent/extensions/lib && nub run --recursive --if-present --sequential format
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json instructions.md agent/scripts/README.md agent/scripts/tui-showcase.ts agent/extensions/*.ts agent/extensions/lib && nub run --recursive --if-present --sequential format:check
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --ignore-pattern agent/extensions/herdr-agent-state.ts agent/extensions/*.ts agent/extensions/lib agent/scripts/tui-showcase.ts && nub run --recursive --if-present --sequential lint
scripts.test: TMPDIR=/tmp nub run --recursive --if-present --sequential test && TMPDIR=/tmp nub run --filter pi-web-ui test:e2e
